description: Post to the shared blackboard (the only write tool; stores text, never sends orders). type observation|hypothesis|question; hypotheses with asset BTC|ETH (Kraken EUR) or BRENT|DIESEL (Yahoo BZ=F/HO=F) + direction + horizon_hours are scored later on real prices.
